## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact rolling window durations (`7`, `14`, `21`, `28` days) and grid placement (`2×2` layout) explicitly specified for all four Pace Cards? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are the header contents of the `GOAL ARRIVAL ESTIMATIONS` card defined both when `cycle.endDate` is set and when `cycle.endDate` is `null`? [Completeness, Spec §US2, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are all four per-row visual elements (Line 1 left pace label, Line 1 right weeks + arrival date, Line 2 sufficiency bar, Line 2 ahead/late badge) specified for each horizon (`7D`, `14D`, `21D`, `28D`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [x] CHK004 Is the 2-decimal precision rule (`0.01 kg/wk` and `0.01 lbs/wk`) unambiguously defined for Pace Cards, Required Pace, and Horizon Estimations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 Is the proportional sufficiency bar formula (`v2 / abs(requiredRate2InUnit)`, clamped to `[0.05f, 1.0f]` when projected and `0f` when stalled/unavailable) explicitly quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 Are the exact thresholds for the ahead/late badge (`weeksDelta < -0.05` -> `"On time (-X.Xw)"`, `abs(weeksDelta) <= 0.05` -> `"On time"`, `weeksDelta > 0.05` -> `"+X.Xw late"`, `isCapped` -> `"> 1 yr late"`) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Do the maturity fallback subtitles (`"Needs weigh-in 14+ days ago"`, `"Needs weigh-in 21+ days ago"`, `"Needs weigh-in 28+ days ago"`, `"Smoothed trend"`) follow a consistent pattern across 14D, 21D, and 28D pace cards? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK008 Are terminal container states (`GoalReached` and `CycleEnded`) evaluated consistently between `computePaceTargets`, `computePaceForecast`, and `computeMultiHorizonForecast`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]

## Edge Case & Non-Functional Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Is the behavior specified when a single horizon is stalled or gaining (`+0.15 kg/wk`) while other horizons remain in deficit? [Edge Case, Spec §US3, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK010 Is the 52-week cap (`> 1 year`) specified for very slow deficit velocities (`rawWeeks > 52.0`)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK011 Are responsive layout constraints (`360dp` viewport width, `130%` accessibility font scale) and merged TalkBack semantics specified? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-007, §SC-003]
